# discord_guild_preview (Data Source)

Reads the public preview of a discoverable Discord guild.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_guild_preview" "example" {
  id = "123456789012345678"
}

output "member_count" {
  value = data.discord_guild_preview.example.approximate_member_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild.

### Read-Only

- `approximate_member_count` (Number) Approximate number of members.
- `approximate_presence_count` (Number) Approximate number of online members.
- `description` (String) Guild description.
- `features` (List of String) Enabled guild feature flags.
- `icon` (String) Guild icon hash.
- `name` (String) Guild name.
